title: Home page look — three directions, pick one

steps.headline: Which overall look should the Home page have?
steps.notice: Whichever you pick sets the feel of every card, button and tab.
steps.risk: Each one changes how everything looks, but nothing moves or works differently.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: The page as it looks now, for comparison.

variants.label: Calm and flat
variants.summary: Room boxes disappear; devices are soft tinted tiles with a thin brightness line and round handle. Lots of air, quiet headings.
variants.risk: Less contrast between sections, so a busy house can feel a little plain.

variants.label: Glass and glow
variants.summary: Raised glass cards with soft shadows; anything that is on glows in its own colour; the open tab is filled with the theme's accent.
variants.risk: Richer but busier; glow and shadows are the most decorated of the three.

variants.label: Clean list
variants.summary: No cards: rooms are titled sections with thin dividers, devices are rows, tabs are underlined. Fits the most on screen.
variants.risk: Plainer and more document-like; devices look less tappable.

steps.headline: Which look should the device pop-up have?
steps.notice: This is what opens when you press and hold or right-click a card.
steps.risk: You can mix: this does not have to match the page look you pick.

steps.headline: Which look should the Activity list have?
steps.notice: The list of what changed in the house today.
steps.risk: Rows differ in how much they stand out from each other.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: The page as it looks now, for comparison.

variants.label: Calm and flat
variants.summary: Flat rows with thin dividers instead of boxes.
variants.risk: Less contrast between sections, so a busy house can feel a little plain.

variants.label: Glass and glow
variants.summary: Each row is a raised card with a coloured edge for the kind of event.
variants.risk: Richer but busier; glow and shadows are the most decorated of the three.

variants.label: Clean list

steps.headline: Which look should the Climate page have?

steps.risk: The weather card is the same in all three; only the surroundings change.
